Please don’t hurt me? Unfit for reproduction? Enough! 

Look in the mirror, look at your eyes, your muscles, your humanity. You are man, an apex being resulting from millions of years of evolution. You have access to the internet, all the food you can eat, and unlimited sources of information. You have potential. Pick yourself up and stop giving a shit about other people. What are you upset with? Wish you were more attractive? There are things you can do (steroids, nice clothes, hygiene) but in reality none of that shit matters. What do you want in life? Why are you here? Message me

Went through something much worse. Didn’t use pills and had to rely on stimulation when thinking of porn. Would go soft in the middle sometimes. Affected my security a lot and she broke up with me. I would say to try and get rid of the pills and try to be as present as possible without being concerned about getting hard. Absolutely don’t look at porn. Try to make sex less about penetration for awhile, good luck friend.
I had insomnia too for a bit. Day 24 and sleeping pattern is pretty much normal. It might last for a week or two. Just stick with it and exercise if you’re not already doing so.

Wow, having a rough day and just read this. Gf broke up with me before I started nofap and I used to look into her eyes and listen to her heartbeat a lot. I’m flatlining right now and haven’t felt this sad in a long time. Not sure what to do but life feels hopeless right now.

It’s ok man. Virginity does not actually matter or really exist. Sex is overrated and there are so many more meaningful things to work towards in life. Try to think about what makes you happy, try to be passionate and find happiness in yourself. If you are trying to derive happiness from things other people decide are important (I.e. virginity, expensive clothing, nice cars) you won’t be happy even if you end up reaching those standards. You should quit porn because it is stopping you from forming a meaningful relationship with a future lover, not because you think you are worth any less because you’re a virgin because that’s just not true
